fullContent:
Somanatha Rasa 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Bahumutra Roga Chikitsa 96/24-27 
 Introduction 
 Somanath Ras is an Ayurvedic medicine which is comprised of herbal and mineral ingredients. This medicine is available in the tablet form. It is used in treating frequent urination problem. But it is advisable to take this medicine only under medical supervision. It balances Vata and Kapha doshas in body. 
 Ingredients 
 20 grams of 
 
 Lohabhasma – Bhasma of Iron 
 
 10 grams of each of 
 
 Rasa – Purified and processed Mercury 
 Gandhaka – Purified Sulphur 
 Ela – Cardamom – Elettaria cardamomum 
 Patra – Cinnamon – Cinnamomum zeylanicum 
 Turmeric – Curcuma longa 
 Daruharidra – Berberis aristata 
 Jambu – Eugenia jambolana 
 Veerana – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Vidanga – Embelia ribes 
 Jiraka – Cumin – Cuminum cyminum 
 Patha – Cyclea peltata 
 Dhatri – Emblica officinalis 
 Dadima – Punica granatum 
 Tankanam – Purified Borax 
 Chandana – Sandalwood – Santalum album 
 Guggulu – Commiphora mukul 
 Lodhra – Symplocos racemosa 
 Shala – Shorea robusta 
 Arjuna – Terminalia arjuna 
 Rasanjana – Aqueous extract of Berberis aristata 
 Goat milk – Base 
 
 Dosage 
 Take 125 mg to 250 mg – 1-2 tablets once or twice a day before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Indications 
 
 Frequent urination problem. 
 Menorrhagia 
 Metrorrhagia 
 Leucoderma 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 This medicine should be taken only under strict medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous. 
 It is to be avoided in children and pregnant ladies. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
